tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: modem-cat is a cross-platform CLI and desktop tool for debugging 5G modems. It supports Quectel and TDTech modems via AT commands over serial or TCP.

tour.title: CLI Entry Point
tour.description: The CLI is the primary interface. src/cli/index.ts parses command-line arguments and dispatches to command handlers. Commands include connect, disconnect, list-ports, status, at, network-info, hardware-info, config, history, help, version.

tour.title: Type System
tour.description: src/core/types/index.ts defines all TypeScript interfaces: Connection, ModemStatus, NetworkInfo, HardwareInfo, ATCommand, CommandHistory, CLIOptions.

tour.title: AT Command Execution
tour.description: AT commands are executed via at-executor.ts. The parser in at-parser.ts handles responses. Commands include CPIN, CGSN, CCID, CGMM, CGMI, GMR, QENG, COPS, QANTRSSI, CGACT, QNETDEVSTATUS, QICSGP, QNWPREREQ.

tour.title: Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL)
tour.description: The Rust HAL in modem-hal/ provides vendor abstractions. ModemVendor trait defines the interface. ModemFactory creates vendor instances. Transports (Serial, TCP) implement AtTransport trait.

tour.title: Vendor Implementations
tour.description: Quectel and TDTech are the supported vendors. Each has vendor-specific AT response parsing in their respective modules.

tour.title: Desktop Application (Tauri)
tour.description: The desktop app uses Tauri with a single-file HTML frontend. The Rust backend exposes Tauri commands for port listing, connection, modem queries, and configuration. at_adapter.rs provides high-level operations using at_parser.rs.

tour.title: Configuration Files
tour.description: Build and deployment configuration: package.json for CLI, Cargo.toml for Rust, tauri.conf.json for desktop, GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
